  • Validation: injection-recovery into off-stream bands (30 realisations), null bands, stability to bands, bin widths, k, init.
  • Against: the 1-D scheme inherits the other masks (pmra off by 1 at 22-26 may bias pmdec there); a joint 3-D mixture avoids that at the cost of a parametric field model.

docs.title: Codex (code review + method)
docs.text:
• Verified flaws in the current scripts: (1) PM backgrounds in the cross-selection scale off-sky histograms by the ratio of ALL stars on/off (not area) -- assumes the same field PM distribution on/off; (2) sky-panel background fits ignore footprint exposure (edges, masks); (3) upper branch not excluded from the sky-panel background bands; (4) marked masks have constant widths, ad hoc spline weights/padding and ignore per-star errors; (5) cross-selection does not remove feedback (masks drawn on an earlier cross-selected figure); (6) displayed significance ignores background uncertainty; (7) the frame/footprint is member-informed (chord frame from the members' ridge).
  • Method: joint, error-convolved Poisson point-process mixture on a fixed parent sample, integrated over the accessible region, with smooth (penalised-spline) tracks, log-widths, amplitudes; EM with soft responsibilities for all stars (hard alternating masks cannot recover excluded wings); compare one broadening component vs two tracks vs non-Gaussian wings by held-out prediction and simulations repeating the whole search (not BIC alone); borders by a declared objective (completeness mask for science, S/N mask for display); 3 marginal 95 per cent masks give ~86 per cent joint completeness; for two tracks use the union of component-consistent selections, not a broad envelope. Freeze the experiment and withhold member labels/CMD until masks are frozen.
  • Against: at these S/N a flexible field model can absorb a broad component and a rigid one can invent one; if defensible backgrounds give different borders, report an uncertain border.

docs.title: Format of the reanalysed observables for model comparison: Fable and Codex (2026-10-23)
Both
docs.text:
• Final likelihood: binned JOINT counts (format B in 3-D, not three marginal maps, which double-count stars and lose the sky-PM association) with Poisson statistics: N_cell ~ Poisson(A m_cell + B_cell), model particles passed through the SAME frozen selection (CMD pass via particle distance + stellar population, G < 20, footprint, GC masks), background from off-sky bands with its uncertainty as nuisance. Keep the stars (for a later star-level mixture C); per-bin summaries (A) for diagnostics/fast searches; no membership-weighted member list (D) for constraints (circular, loses density/wings).
  • The tight k = 2 masks must not be the likelihood domain; keep the upper branch inside.
  • End-to-end injection of model streams into the real field (rerunning masks/dm) is the required validation; nulls; convergence.

docs.title: Fable (checks on saved sprays and the data)
docs.text:
• Tight masks keep only 54-72% of the 12.5-deg model's debris at phi1 -2..22 (8-28% beyond 22); 25-deg 33-67% / 3-23%: model sky MAD 1.7-2.5 deg vs data 1.0-1.2; model pmra 1.3-2.1 vs 1.1-1.2 mas/yr; 12.5-deg model sky 1.3-3.8 deg below the data beyond 22.
  • S/B per 4-deg bin in the tight masks 0.1-2.3; in a loose box B/S 10-25 -> background accuracy sets the ceiling.
  • Product: obs_cube (phi1 2-deg x dphi2 0.25 x pmra 0.25 x pmdec 0.2-0.25 over the full box, absolute coordinates, ~13M cells, OFF bands inside; exclude cube for the b = 8 artefact, GC masks, footprint); selection.json (tracks/widths for marked/free/orbit starts, include rule k ~ 4 PMs and |dphi2 - c| < 8, OFF bands 5-14, CMD mask + dm line, footprint cuts); cmd_pass_curve per column (expected observable stars per template star vs particle dm offset, with A_G and G < 20); dm_bins (with template Hess + background so the same dm fit runs on the model's predicted Hess); vlos_stars; null include rules (+-6 mas/yr).
  • Model side: particles -> frame -> masks -> weight n_obs(dm_p - dm_line) -> histogram -> smooth (h + error class) -> m_cell; ~0.5-1 s per evaluation (spray itself 90-4600 s). Per-column amplitude profiled by default (density-free), global optional.
  • dm term: Gaussian per bin on fit-to-fit difference (x2), plus a global offset nuisance (0.1 mag). Model dm vs line within 0.1 at 0-22, 0.1-0.26 fainter beyond 22; discriminates at 0.1-0.2 mag.
  • No carry-over of T ~ 2; calibrate overdispersion from seed scatter and injection coverage.
  • Tests: nulls (A_k ~ 0, flat residuals); injection + model discrimination (12.5 vs 25 injected); mask-start robustness of the ranking; seed convergence vs N; continuity with the STREAMFINDER conditional score.
  • Against: result as good as the background; 3-5% error in the dphi2 interpolation of the field PM distribution makes fake wing signal of the size of model differences.

docs.title: Codex (read code)
docs.text:
• Current score is not fully density-free (mixing weight depends on f_u).
  • Exports not usable as-is: one-parameter errors, overlapping bins; PM display counts vs background windows differ (SKYH vs SKY_HALF); dm background fixed in profile; quadratic relation uses raw errors; upper branch excluded from the sky fit.
  • Deliverables: stars.parquet (all columns incl. errors, flags, region flags), cells.npz (fixed joint cells in phi1, dphi2, pmra, pmdec, c0, G0; zero cells kept), background.npz (control counts, model, covariance), summaries.npz (bootstrap covariances, full dm likelihood grids), manifest.json (hashes, frame, selection inequalities, CMD template, completeness). Boolean CMD mask is not the Gaia completeness function (GaiaUnlimited: catalogue inclusion x sample selection).
  • Model: integrate a luminosity function per particle (not one random star), G < 20, extinction, errors, parallax cut, completeness; frozen data selection; correlated PM errors; both branches; global amplitude keeps density, per-bin discards it; release history as nuisance. Do not multiply by dm summaries from the same stars (CMD in the cells instead).
  • Against: a full count likelihood may turn uncertain background/completeness/population into falsely precise bar constraints; if injections show that, use A as primary.

docs.title: Single-component sky fit: Fable and Codex (2026-10-24)
docs.text: Briefing: the single-component sky spline fit (key dphi2_W6ext_nohole: extended likelihood, fixed band background, +-6 deg, phi1 0-28, no cap, no branch mask) as a knot data vector for spray models; proposed fix: phi1 0-25, width cap 1.5, +-0.7 deg mask around the two-component branch track at phi1 14-22.

docs.title: Bugs (both verified by Claude in bin/streams/stream_spline_fit.py)
docs.text:
• Hole inconsistency (Codex, Fable): with the branch hole on, stars are removed but the extended stream integral uses Ag (area only, no hole). Fable: for the W6ext_nohole model 97 expected stream stars (18% of the phi1 14-23 stream) lie in the hole. No effect on --nohole runs.
  • Mocks (Fable; Codex: "--test does not generate Poisson realisations"): simulate() uses curves()["f"] as a probability, but with --extended curves() returns the rate (exp of the spline, 20-70 /deg), so every mock star is a stream star.

docs.title: Checks (Fable, scratchpad runs, hole fixed in the integral)
docs.text:
• phi1 3-9: excess 122 +- 30 stars (4 sigma) on ~100-160 background per deg; stacked single Gaussian centre -1.51, width 0.97; local 6-deg windows width 2.0 +- 0.5 (phi1 4.5), 0.84 +- 0.32 (7.5). The global fit's 2.6-4.5 deg (saved: 4.52 at phi1 8) is a knot-placement artefact (width knots 0, 8.3, 12.5; the broad 9-12 overlap, width 1.9 +- 0.5, leaks into 3-9).
  • phi1 14-18: two bands of near-equal weight (centres -0.28 / +2.39, widths 0.77 / 0.90); one Gaussian -> centroid +1.5, width 1.8. Two-component vs one-component (cap 1.5) on the same 4069 stars: Delta lnL 37.5, Delta AIC 51.
  • Variants: A (cap 1.5, phi1 0-25): width at the cap everywhere, track +1.66 at phi1 15. B (A + +-0.7 branch mask): still at the cap 0-16.5, track +1.33 (15): the strip removes only ~55% of a 0.9-deg branch. C (mask, no cap): width 3.9-4.9 at 3-9 again. Residual sd 0.98 does not discriminate (background-dominated pixels).

docs.title: Recommendations
docs.text:
• Both: describe the main band only (option a), not the centroid of main + branch; apply the same mask/aperture to particles.
  • Fable: replace the global AIC spline by local fits at fixed knots (every 3 deg, +-3 deg windows, Gaussian + fixed band background; Koposov+2023 style), branch strip +-1.2 deg at phi1 13-22, knot 13.5 flagged as overlap; widths at 3-9 are limits. Acceptance: centres within 0.3 deg of the two-component main track at 15-22; -1.5 +- 0.3 at 3-9; no width at a bound; errors from 20 Poisson mocks within 20% of quoted. Against: overlapping windows correlate knots; non-overlapping 3-deg windows instead.
  • Codex: fix selection/diagnostic consistency (one exclusion function for stars, integrals, mocks, plots; plot the fit's own background, not an independent one); freeze aperture and knots; caps only as sensitivity checks; >= 100 Poisson realisations (single band, branch, fan, perturbed background), track AND width bias and coverage; save full provenance (flags) with each result. Against: the branch/fan may carry the bar signal, and "main" may be arbitrary; if a core cannot be recovered across plausible models, use (b) with explicit aperture moments.
  • Codex correction: the saved fit already widens at phi1 24 (1.66 deg), 13 deg at 28.

docs.title: Two-component measurement set-up and the way forward for modelling: Fable and Codex (2026-10-24)
docs.text: Briefing: main/branch spline fits (stream_spline_fit.py: 1-component PMs, 2-component extended sky fit dphi2_sky_final, per-band PMs in +-1 deg windows), branch characterisation, branch sweep pilot; user proposal: use the two-component description as the data vector (S5-style knot Gaussian likelihood with nuisance sigma).

docs.title: Both
docs.text:
• The knot vector is NOT a calibrated data vector yet; do not rescore the archive with it and read the ranking as evidence.
  • Degenerate/boundary knots (verified by Claude): main width knots at phi1 0, 8.3 saturate the 1.5-deg cap (raw 16604, 1051); pmra_branch at 18.7 width 2.25 mas/yr, f = 1.0 (background absorbed); branch end knots unconstrained.
  • Knots are correlated (Claude verified: m 8.3/16.7 r = -0.50, 16.7/25 -0.58, m2 18.7/23 -0.70): full covariance, not diagonal.
  • Model side: band assignment by data windows is unsound (branch_sweep.py); prefer a likelihood on the full particle density, which needs no labels; a single-band model is then penalised by the missing density.
  • Particle support must be uniform: chi > 0, age cut, enough particles (Fable: 8k particles -> lnL sd 7-9, biased low 8-12; 179k -> sd 1.4-1.8); spray_grid4 (8k) and the ~1k-particle training/wave sets cannot be used for ranking.

docs.title: Fable (checked with short scripts on stored sprays)
docs.text:
• Profiled nuisance sigma (Koposov+2023 Sec 5.3 style) makes the knot likelihood non-discriminating: knot chi2 438-865 for 4 models -> -2lnL 6-8 (main) with sigma_nuis 1.7-2.2 deg; the nuisance absorbs a wrong-band model.
  • Stored sprays decompose into "ridge (1.0-1.5 deg) + broad fan", not main + branch; model ridge widths 1.0-2.5 vs data 0.6-1.5.
  • Extended Poisson sky likelihood (data stars + fixed band background + histogram-KDE of particles, h 0.4 x 0.3 deg): < 0.1 s per model; dlnL vs background-only +164..+265 for 4 models (data spline +424); model differences stable to bandwidth (w3 - null 78.5-79.1 for h 0.25-1.0).
  • Recommends (b): extended sky term with a free low-order rate spline + score_conditional PM term with the empirical off-sky backgrounds; one completeness factor per band; mock-calibrated tempering. Rescore only >= 90k-particle sets (~1850).
  • Against own choice: sprays' morphology (2x too wide, fans) may drive bar parameters through the fan, not the track.

docs.title: Codex (code reading, no runs)
docs.text:
• Recommends (a) only for screening; production (d): a joint binned sky x PM shape likelihood per phi1 slice, conditional on the slice total (no along-stream rates, no luminosity-function modelling), error-convolved particles + empirical field with off-region constraint; smooth relative-efficiency nuisance between bands.
  • Background uncertainty must enter (area map is from star counts; band cells overlap the +-6 fit window); covariance is conditional on AIC knots and frozen masks; per-band PMs measure selected windows, scalar errors (no Gaia pmra-pmdec correlation).
  • Sprays may be generated with one launch arm; differing age cuts across files -> require common support, regenerate.
  • Saved branch dm +0.26 +- 0.16 is not bias-corrected (the ~0.36 figure is Claude's estimate, not the saved value).
  • Gates: reproducible manifest; >= 200 measurement-recovery realisations (pull sd 0.9-1.1, coverage); label/morphology tests; Monte Carlo error < 0.2 sigma; null false-branch rate; parameter recovery at several truths (bias < 0.3 sigma); only then the archive.

docs.title: Synthesis (Claude)
docs.text: Agreement: drop the knot vector as the likelihood; score the full model density against the data with fixed empirical backgrounds, conditional on along-stream density (free rate spline or per-slice totals); uniform particle support; mock-based calibration before trusting rankings. Difference: Fable's unbinned extended sky term + existing conditional PM term (fast, already prototyped) vs Codex's joint binned sky x PM per slice (keeps sky-PM association). Spline fits remain diagnostics and the figures of the paper.
